    uid=885_187 link "03 MirrorFly IM Software INTRO & LEARNING MirrorFly is a self-hosted instant messaging software that enables businesses to create a white-label team chat and meeting app. The solution combines private messaging, voice calling, video conferencing, and collaboration features into a single mobile and web app. Organizations can deploy the MirrorFly IM solution in their own data center, private cloud, or other preferred hosting environments. This helps organizations build secure internal communication platforms that grow along with their business." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190151"
    uid=885_192 link "04 AV1 Encoding with libsvtav1 on Qencode ENCODING & CODECS The libsvtav1 encoder (SVT-AV1) is an AV1 implementation tuned for both compression efficiency and parallel performance. It gives concrete starting points: preset 3 for archival, preset 8 for fast turnaround, preset 5 with CRF 30-35 for web streaming, and fast_decode when targeting low-power devices such as set-top boxes and budget phones.     uid=888_370 link "01 PyTorchVideoCompression ENCODING & CODECS PyTorch implementations of learned video compression methods (DVC, FVC, DCVC and related neural codecs) with training and inference code used as a common research baseline." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190359"
    uid=888_375 link "02 MediaMTX — Zero-Dependency Real-Time Media Server (Official Docs) INFRASTRUCTURE & DELIVERY Official documentation for MediaMTX, a zero-dependency real-time media server and proxy that publishes, reads and converts between RTSP, RTMP, SRT, HLS and WebRTC on a per-path basis. Covers protocol-specific ingest/egress configuration, recording, authentication and the REST control API." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190342"
    uid=888_380 link "03 MirrorFly IM Software INTRO & LEARNING MirrorFly is a self-hosted instant messaging software that enables businesses to create a white-label team chat and meeting app. The solution combines private messaging, voice calling, video conferencing, and collaboration features into a single mobile and web app. Organizations can deploy the MirrorFly IM solution in their own data center, private cloud, or other preferred hosting environments. This flexibility gives enterprises control over infrastructure, data storage, and security policies. The solution provides full source code access and enables developers to customize features and workflows for various businesses. It comes with a perpetual one-time license and is ideal for long-term cost value. It's designed with a scalable messaging architecture and low-latency communication. This helps organizations build secure internal communication platforms that grow along with their business." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190151"
    uid=888_385 link "04 AV1 Encoding with libsvtav1 on Qencode ENCODING & CODECS The libsvtav1 encoder (SVT-AV1) is an AV1 implementation tuned for both compression efficiency and parallel performance. This guide covers the preset scale from 0 to 13 and its speed-versus-efficiency trade-off, CRF selection in the 20-40 range, MP4 versus WebM output, and advanced controls including tune, aq_mode, film_grain, fast_decode, enable_dlf, enable_restoration, hierarchical_levels and pred_struct. It gives concrete starting points: preset 3 for archival, preset 8 for fast turnaround, preset 5 with CRF 30-35 for web streaming, and fast_decode when targeting low-power devices such as set-top boxes and budget phones. On why AV1 at all: roughly 30-40% bitrate savings versus H.264 and 20-30% versus HEVC or VP9 at equivalent quality, royalty-free under the Alliance for Open Media, with decode support in Chrome, Firefox and Edge." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190152"
    uid=888_390 link "05 MLVC: Multi-platform Learned Video Codec for Real-World Deployment ENCODING & CODECS Academic paper on a neural video codec targeting competitive compression, real-time speed, and cross-platform (Apple/Intel/Qualcomm NPU) inference." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190135"

Covers protocol-specific ingest/egress configuration, recording, authentication and the REST control API." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190342"
    uid=908_380 link "03 MirrorFly IM Software INTRO & LEARNING MirrorFly is a self-hosted instant messaging software that enables businesses to create a white-label team chat and meeting app. The solution combines private messaging, voice calling, video conferencing, and collaboration features into a single mobile and web app. Organizations can deploy the MirrorFly IM solution in their own data center, private cloud, or other preferred hosting environments. This flexibility gives enterprises control over infrastructure, data storage, and security policies. The solution provides full source code access and enables developers to customize features and workflows for various businesses. It comes with a perpetual one-time license and is ideal for long-term cost value. It's designed with a scalable messaging architecture and low-latency communication. This helps organizations build secure internal communication platforms that grow along with their business." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190151"
    uid=908_385 link "04 AV1 Encoding with libsvtav1 on Qencode ENCODING & CODECS The libsvtav1 encoder (SVT-AV1) is an AV1 implementation tuned for both compression efficiency and parallel performance. This guide covers the preset scale from 0 to 13 and its speed-versus-efficiency trade-off, CRF selection in the 20-40 range, MP4 versus WebM output, and advanced controls including tune, aq_mode, film_grain, fast_decode, enable_dlf, enable_restoration, hierarchical_levels and pred_struct. It gives concrete starting points: preset 3 for archival, preset 8 for fast turnaround, preset 5 with CRF 30-35 for web streaming, and fast_decode when targeting low-power devices such as set-top boxes and budget phones. On why AV1 at all: roughly 30-40% bitrate savings versus H.264 and 20-30% versus HEVC or VP9 at equivalent quality, royalty-free under the Alliance for Open Media, with decode support in Chrome, Firefox and Edge." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190152"

    uid=908_375 link "02 MediaMTX — Zero-Dependency Real-Time Media Server (Official Docs) INFRASTRUCTURE & DELIVERY Official documentation for MediaMTX, a zero-dependency real-time media server and proxy that publishes, reads and converts between RTSP, RTMP, SRT, HLS and WebRTC on a per-path basis. Covers protocol-specific ingest/egress configuration, recording, authentication and the REST control API." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190342"
    uid=908_380 link "03 MirrorFly IM Software INTRO & LEARNING MirrorFly is a self-hosted instant messaging software that enables businesses to create a white-label team chat and meeting app. The solution combines private messaging, voice calling, video conferencing, and collaboration features into a single mobile and web app. Organizations can deploy the MirrorFly IM solution in their own data center, private cloud, or other preferred hosting environments. This flexibility gives enterprises control over infrastructure, data storage, and security policies. The solution provides full source code access and enables developers to customize features and workflows for various businesses. It comes with a perpetual one-time license and is ideal for long-term cost value. It's designed with a scalable messaging architecture and low-latency communication. This helps organizations build secure internal communication platforms that grow along with their business." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190151"
    uid=908_385 link "04 AV1 Encoding with libsvtav1 on Qencode ENCODING & CODECS The libsvtav1 encoder (SVT-AV1) is an AV1 implementation tuned for both compression efficiency and parallel performance. This guide covers the preset scale from 0 to 13 and its speed-versus-efficiency trade-off, CRF selection in the 20-40 range, MP4 versus WebM output, and advanced controls including tune, aq_mode, film_grain, fast_decode, enable_dlf, enable_restoration, hierarchical_levels and pred_struct. It gives concrete starting points: preset 3 for archival, preset 8 for fast turnaround, preset 5 with CRF 30-35 for web streaming, and fast_decode when targeting low-power devices such as set-top boxes and budget phones. On why AV1 at all: roughly 30-40% bitrate savings versus H.264 and 20-30% versus HEVC or VP9 at equivalent quality, royalty-free under the Alliance for Open Media, with decode support in Chrome, Firefox and Edge." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190152"
    uid=908_390 link "05 MLVC: Multi-platform Learned Video Codec for Real-World Deployment ENCODING & CODECS Academic paper on a neural video codec targeting competitive compression, real-time speed, and cross-platform (Apple/Intel/Qualcomm NPU) inference." url="https://awesome.video/resource/190135"

      uid=1038_3 "A simple, fast tool to inject metadata (onMetaData) into FLV files. Yamdi can also insert an onLastSecond event and is often used to prepare live-recorded FLV files for on-demand playback by adding missing metadata for durations and keyframes."
